data.narrative:
Ayar Labs, an AI & Software company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, is valued at $3.75B post-money at Series E, having raised $870M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including stage-adjacent names such as Applied Intuition (Series F, $15.0B), Wayve (Series D, $8.6B), and SandboxAQ (Series E, $5.8B).

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier from Series E to the next funding stage, implies a valuation of $5.2B. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps yields a median of $8.6B, with a range of $5.8B to $15.0B. The peer median method reflects broader market positioning within the AI & Software frontier-tech space.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $4.5B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The current $3.75B valuation sits below the low end of this range, suggesting either discount to peers or material execution risk priced in. Key uncertainties include the proprietary technology's competitive durability, customer concentration, and path to revenue scale—typical constraints for early-stage frontier tech at this valuation stage.
